component: N20 packed-prefill MLP materialization and grouped GDN evaluation experiment
license: mlx2 project license for original local code

external_research.use: Research prompt for comparing explicit affine-weight dequantization followed by BF16 matrix multiplication against stock quantized matmul at large M.

modifications: Added default-off staged and single-evaluation stock quantized-matmul modes.
Added default-off staged and single-evaluation full-table BF16 dequantization modes with explicit three-projection temporary-memory charge.
Added an explicit expanded-charge profile for grouping all three N3 GDN segments into one evaluation wave.
Bound every experimental mode to the N20 candidate profile and route receipt; ordinary decode and production defaults are unchanged.

validation.correctness: All completed arms preserved exact HTTP token, text, finish and usage parity and real native route-use proof.
validation.performance: Full-table BF16 dequantization and one-evaluation MLP scheduling were rejected. GDN wave4 reduced the paired native regression from 6.34 percent to 3.20 percent but did not pass admission.
